PowerShell(Write-Host "=== Silver 层 ==="; Get-ChildItem "output\\silver" | Select-Object Name, @{N='Size\(KB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}}; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "=== Excel 报告 ==="; Get-ChildItem "output\\report" | Select-Object Name, @{N='Size\(KB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}}; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "=== Gold 表总数 ==="; \(Get-ChildItem "output\\gold"\).Count; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "=== 客户全景摘要 ==="; python -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv\('output/gold/客户全景.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'\); print\(f'客户数: {len\(df\)}'\); print\(f'列数: {len\(df.columns\)}'\); print\(f'综合价值层级分布: {df[\\"综合价值层级\\"].value_counts\(\).to_dict\(\) if \\"综合价值层级\\" in df.columns else \\"N/A\\"}'\)")

PowerShell(python -c "import pandas as pd; import sys; sys.path.insert\(0, '.'\); df=pd.read_csv\('output/gold/客户全景.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig'\); print\('客户数:', len\(df\)\); print\('列数:', len\(df.columns\)\); tiers=df['综合价值层级'].value_counts\(\).to_dict\(\) if '综合价值层级' in df.columns else {}; print\('综合价值层级分布:', tiers\)")

PowerShell(Write-Host "========================================"; Write-Host "  全量运行完成 - 输出汇总"; Write-Host "========================================"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Silver 层 \(output/silver/\):"; Get-ChildItem "output\\silver" | ForEach-Object { $size = [math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB, 1\); Write-Host "  $\($_.Name\)  \($size KB\)" }; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Gold 层 \(output/gold/\) - $\(\(Get-ChildItem 'output\\gold'\).Count\) 张表:"; Get-ChildItem "output\\gold" | ForEach-Object { $size = [math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB, 1\); Write-Host "  $\($_.Name\)  \($size KB\)" }; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Excel 报告 \(output/report/\):"; Get-ChildItem "output\\report" | ForEach-Object { $size = [math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB, 1\); Write-Host "  $\($_.Name\)  \($size KB\)" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "output\\silver" | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-ChildItem "output\\gold" | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-ChildItem "output\\report" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Cache cleared")
